Instructions_EN: From hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep pelvis level; avoid arching the lower back.

Instructions_EN: Arch and round the back slowly while on hands and knees.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Move segmentally; focus on breath coordination.

Instructions_EN: Flatten lower back against the floor, then arch slightly.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Focus on deep core activation (TA); minimal leg involvement.

Instructions_EN: Lift hips toward the ceiling while lying on your back.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Squeeze glutes at the top; avoid excessive lumbar extension.

Instructions_EN: Lift chest slightly off the floor while lying face down.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep gaze down to protect the neck; focus on mid-back extension.

Instructions_EN: On back, legs at 90°, lower opposite arm and leg slowly.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Maintain posterior pelvic tilt; keep lower back flat on floor.

Instructions_EN: Hold a straight body line supported by forearms and toes.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Prevent hip sagging; push away from the floor with shoulders.

Instructions_EN: Support body on one forearm and side of the feet.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep head, torso, and legs in a straight line; avoid rotation.

Instructions_EN: Lift head, shoulders, and legs off the floor, arms extended.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Ensure lower back remains in contact with the mat throughout.

Instructions_EN: Push the band forward from your chest, resisting lateral pull.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Maintain neutral spine; do not let the band rotate your torso.

Instructions_EN: Lie on side with knees bent, lift top knee while keeping feet together.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Maintain neutral pelvis; do not roll the hips backward.

Instructions_EN: Place band around ankles or knees, walk sideways with knees slightly bent.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep toes pointing forward; maintain a slight squat position.

Instructions_EN: Perform a glute bridge while lifting one leg straight out.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep hips level; do not let the pelvis drop on the unsupported side.

Instructions_EN: Lie on side, lift top leg straight up towards the ceiling.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep the leg slightly behind the midline; avoid rotating the foot upward.

Instructions_EN: Stand on one leg on a step, lower and lift the opposite hip.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep the standing leg straight; focus on the lateral hip muscles (Glute Med).

Instructions_EN: Sit with leg straight, push the back of the knee down into a towel.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Focus on a strong VMO (inner quad) contraction; hold for 5-10 sec.

Instructions_EN: Stand with band behind knee, straighten the knee against resistance.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Focus on full extension; do not let the band "snap" the knee back.

Instructions_EN: Step up onto a platform, focusing on pushing through the heel.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep the knee aligned with the second toe; avoid knee valgus.

Instructions_EN: Lean against a wall and slide down into a squat, holding the position.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep knees at 90 degrees; ensure lower back is flat against the wall.

Instructions_EN: Lie on back, keep one leg straight and lift it to the level of the other knee.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Lock the knee fully before lifting; avoid arching the lower back.

Instructions_EN: Stand on the edge of a step and lift your heels as high as possible.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Control the descent (eccentric phase); keep weight on the big toe.

Instructions_EN: Balance on one leg for as long as possible without holding onto anything.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep a "soft" knee; focus on ankle "micro-adjustments" for balance.

Instructions_EN: Loop band around foot, pull the foot outward against resistance.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Move only the ankle, not the whole leg; isolate the peroneal muscles.

Instructions_EN: Walk in a straight line, placing the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Look forward, not down; use arms for balance if needed.

Instructions_EN: Move the feet up and down as far as possible.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Focus on full range of motion; useful for early post-op or edema.

Instructions_EN: Move fingers through a sequence: hook fist, full fist, flat fist.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Reduces adhesions after injury; move slowly and smoothly.

Instructions_EN: Hold a weight, move the wrist side to side (thumb side to pinky side).
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep the forearm flat on a table to isolate the wrist movement.

Instructions_EN: Press palms together in front of chest, lower hands to increase stretch.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Hold for 30 seconds; avoid sharp pain in the carpal tunnel area.

Instructions_EN: Tuck thumb into palm, close fingers over it, and bend wrist towards pinky.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Targets De Quervain's tenosynovitis; perform gently.

Instructions_EN: Clasp hands together and rotate the wrists in circular motions.
Clinical_Tips_EN: Keep the movement fluid; useful for warming up before strength work.
